briefs.speaker_context: Global Market Strategist at J.P. Morgan Asset Management
briefs.current_title: 摩根资管Marcel：美债收益率飙升，是配置机会还是周期压力？
current_title_lines: 配置机会还是周期压力？

subtitles.zh: 让我们请出摩根资管的全球市场策略师Marcel LaChalle。顺便说一句，很高兴见到你。早上好。
subtitles.en: Let's bring in Marcel LaChalle here and set with us global market strategies at JP Morgan asset management. You guys have been advocating very nice to see you by the way. Good morning.

subtitles.zh: 早上好。我们主张更关注固定收益。确实如此。10年期和30年期国债收益率分别突破5.2%和5.5%。我们认为它再次变得有吸引力。
subtitles.en: Good morning. Advocating to have a closer look at fixed income. Yes, indeed. With Treasury, you're surpassing like 10 years and also 30 years surpassing 5.2 and 5.5%. We think it's becoming more attractive again.

subtitles.zh: 确实，触发这一切的原因多种多样，包括财政可持续性担忧、通胀问题以及信誉因素。因此，这些都是长期性问题。
subtitles.en: And indeed, there have been various reasons triggering all these with the fiscal sustainability concerns, inflation issues, and also fact credibility. As such, these are all long-term issues.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们主张更关注短端国债收益率以及投资级公司债。因为我们看到经济动能仍然相当强劲。
subtitles.en: So we're advocating a closer look into probably a shorter and treasuries yields and also investment grade corporate bonds. And because we see how the economic momentum remains quite robust.

subtitles.zh: 这实际上应该会支撑高收益债的违约率保持在相对低位，并使其利差维持较窄。这难道只是我们正在回归常态的感觉吗？
subtitles.en: That should actually support it for the default rate for high yield to also become, say, relatively low and pressed to be quite tight. Is this just a sense that we're just heading back to normal?

subtitles.zh: 我的意思是，后疫情时代那种0%利率的日子已经一去不复返了。但我想，这是否正如你一直所说的，我们看到的并不是真正的经济困境。
subtitles.en: I mean, gone are the days that we used to see 0% rates post-COVID, the like. But I think is it just that then actually what you've been saying, that this is not really economic distress that we're seeing.

subtitles.zh: 更多是与财政可持续性有关。而且这实际上是一个全球现象。不仅仅是在美国，我们在英国和欧洲等地也看到了。
subtitles.en: The law and is more with regards to fiscal sustainability. And it's actually global phenomenon too. It's not just US we see in UK and Europe, etc.

briefs.speaker_context: Global Market Strategist at J.P. Morgan Asset Management
briefs.current_title: 摩根资管Marcel：AI叙事进入现实检验，配置逻辑要变了？

subtitles.zh: 是的，我们正在关注。我想接着Evon的问题说。我认为这是AI故事以来第一次，投资者在收益方面有了替代选择。所以投资者在思考：我需要收益吗？我需要增长动能吗？我们该如何思考这两种策略之间的平衡与取舍？
subtitles.en: Yeah, we are on that, right? I think it's just to build on Evon's question. I think it's the first time since the AI story that there is an alternative in terms of income for investors, right? So investors looking at do I need income? Do I

subtitles.zh: 在权益方面，我们认为我们仍然持建设性看法，但要保持选择性，因为我们看到AI支出仍在扩张，经济动能仍然强劲。但现金的吸引力正在下降，所以权益表现仍然不错。
subtitles.en: In terms of equity, we think we're still constructive on equity as well, but then stay selective because we see AI investment spending is still expanding, and economic momentum is still strong. But then cash is becoming less attractive, so

subtitles.zh: 然后在AI叙事方面，我们认为现在市场正在提出更多疑问。因此他们可能没有完全定价，或者没有完全看好所有AI发展。
subtitles.en: And then in terms of the AI story, we think right now, they are raising more doubts about it. And so they may not be as fully pricing in or fully be nice about all the AI developments.

subtitles.zh: 我们会质疑可行性，例如所有这些安全漏洞，以及相关的立法和法律风险，还有所有这些模型未来的商业可行性，以及它将如何发展。
subtitles.en: We'll question about the feasibility, for example, with all these security breaches, and then the related legislation and also legal risks that may be associated, as well as also a commercial viability of all these models going forward, and

subtitles.zh: 对我们来说，这似乎是技术发展过去经历过的一个发展阶段。所以这更像是对所有技术设备和模型所发生情况的一次现实检验，而且这实际上正在现实世界中被测试。
subtitles.en: And to us, it seems like it's a development stage that has happened in the past with technological development. So it's more like a reality check of what has happened with all the technological devices and all the models, and that's actuall

subtitles.zh: 所以展望未来，我们仍然认为，所有对AI的敞口，无论是风险还是机会，不仅仅与股市有关，也与固定收益、基金有关，还与私募资产相互关联，比如实物资产和基础设施，也许还会回到公开权益市场。
subtitles.en: So going forward, we still think with all the exposure to AI, whether it's risk or opportunity, it's not just related to stock market, but also related to fixed income, to funds, and also interlinked with private assets too, like real asset

subtitles.zh: 但这表明，对AI的敞口仍将融入整个组合配置中，并将在未来几年继续影响投资者的组合构建。
subtitles.en: But that suggests that exposure to AI will still be into a whole portfolio allocation and still affecting investors' portfolio construction going forward in the years ahead.

briefs.current_title: 摩根资管Marcel：亚洲AI赢家怎么选？中国性价比路线被低估？
current_title_lines: 中国性价比路线被低估？

subtitles.zh: 那么亚洲处于什么位置？显然该地区从整个AI建设中受益。你现在如何区分AI与非AI，或者赢家与输家？这很难。很多投资者会继续问，我是不是应该尝试构建一个非AI组合，只是为了避开所有这些波动？目前这非常困难。
subtitles.en: So where does that leave Asia? I mean, obviously the region has benefited from this whole AI build out. How do you separate between AI and on AI, or winners and losers right now? It's just hard. A lot of investors will continue asking, oh,

subtitles.zh: 但对我们来说，不是要完全避开AI，因为如今这不可能做到。而是要识别不同阶段，之前是超大规模企业，我们称之为AI支出者，现在是AI拥有者，比如在台湾、韩国和日本建设硬件的公司正在从中受益。
subtitles.en: But to us, it's not about avoiding AI completely, because it's impossible to do that in nowadays. But to identify the stages, different stages, before it was like from the hyperscaler, so we say it's AI spenders, and now it's the AI owners,

subtitles.zh: 但我们需要提前思考几步，所以现在可能是AI用户进入各个领域，比如医疗保健，以及机器人领域，中国在那里具有竞争优势。
subtitles.en: But we need to think a few steps ahead, so right now it may be the AI users into various sectors like healthcare and also into robotics, where China has a competitive advantage.

subtitles.en: The key reason why we've been active is actually it's been a very strong source of idea generation. Because you have a whole lot of new sectors, companies, those that you just ran through, that are coming to market.

subtitles.en: And so, when you've got a strong combination of good fundamentals, these are very interesting companies, some of them leading edge, and if they come to market at a reasonable valuation,

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.
- Do not mechanically copy examples or proper nouns from instructions. Derive every noun, number, actor, and comparison from this clip and its evidence card.
- angle_id, emotion_pole, and viewer_reaction are private editorial metadata. Never copy their wording into title or title_lines.
- Final cover structure should be [specific subject] / [unexpected fact or comparison] / [concrete unresolved consequence], not [speaker category] / [editorial label] / [topic].
- If a person or institution is genuinely recognizable, use its verified proper name. If it is not recognizable, omit the identity and lead with the subject and fact; do not replace it with generic labels such as 外资策略师 or 海外专家.
- For names and technical terms, use only the current clip's verified title_label. Never use official_zh/legal company names as cover copy, and never invent a Chinese transliteration when title_label is empty or English.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is a source label, not the expert or actor. Company legal suffixes do not belong in a title.
- For China-related clips, never attack China or imply national decline. Favor confidence, competence, policy room, industrial strength, cost advantage, talent, resilience, and competitors being forced to respond.
- If the clip is negative about China and no constructive factual angle exists, use a neutral mechanism question instead of nationalist or doom framing.
- Forbidden title words: 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Forbidden hard-negative wording: 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not use sensitive geopolitical or military subjects, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbered prefixes.
- If evidence cannot support four dramatic factual claims, vary the framing and use strong questions; never fabricate the missing drama.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.

briefs.speaker: Nicholas Choi
briefs.current_title: 富兰克林邓普顿蔡崇信：新股配置策略，长期持有还是二级加仓？
current_title_lines: 富兰克林邓普顿蔡崇信

subtitles.zh: 你们是在二级市场进入，还是试图获得配售？我知道这有点笼统，但持有期大概是怎样的？
subtitles.en: Do you come in in the secondary market, or do you try and get an allocation? I know this is generalizing things, but what's the holding period looking like?

subtitles.zh: 是的。我们试图在新股发行时参与这些交易，并长期持有。这是我们的基础。最佳类型的新股参与者。没错。
subtitles.en: Yeah. So, we've tried to go into these deals at IPO, and hold on to them. So, that's been our base. The best type of IPO investor. Correct.

subtitles.zh: 这仍然占大多数，我们能够获得不错的配售，以好价格持有，在某些情况下我们也会在上市后加仓。
subtitles.en: And that's still the large majority of that, where we've been able to get decent allocations that we're able to hang on at a good price, and I guess where there are certain circumstances where we've actually added on post market as well.

subtitles.zh: 因为配售非常难获得。所以并不是说我在新股发行时就能得到我真正想要的完整配售。
subtitles.en: Because allocations are very difficult to come by. So, it isn't like I get the full allocation that I really want at the IPO itself.

subtitles.zh: 所以实际上有很多情况下我们不得不加仓。但有趣的是，我们对这些加仓标的的信心水平相当高。
subtitles.en: So, there are actually numerous cases where we've had to add on. But the interesting thing here is the conviction levels that we have on these names, where we add on, would be quite high.

subtitles.zh: 因为我们做功课，花时间，但最终它代表了在中国呈现给我们的新机会集。过去我们无法参与。
subtitles.en: Because we do the work, we're spending the time, but ultimately it represents a new opportunity set that's actually presented to us in China. That, you know, kind of in the past, we wouldn't have been able to invest in.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

briefs.current_title: 摩根资管Marcel：美债收益率飙升，是配置机会还是周期压力？
current_title_lines: 配置机会还是周期压力？

subtitles.zh: 让我们请出摩根资管的全球市场策略师Marcel LaChalle。顺便说一句，很高兴见到你。早上好。
subtitles.en: Let's bring in Marcel LaChalle here and set with us global market strategies at JP Morgan asset management. You guys have been advocating very nice to see you by the way. Good morning.

subtitles.zh: 早上好。我们主张更关注固定收益。确实如此。10年期和30年期国债收益率分别突破5.2%和5.5%。我们认为它再次变得有吸引力。
subtitles.en: Good morning. Advocating to have a closer look at fixed income. Yes, indeed. With Treasury, you're surpassing like 10 years and also 30 years surpassing 5.2 and 5.5%. We think it's becoming more attractive again.

subtitles.zh: 确实，触发这一切的原因多种多样，包括财政可持续性担忧、通胀问题以及信誉因素。因此，这些都是长期性问题。
subtitles.en: And indeed, there have been various reasons triggering all these with the fiscal sustainability concerns, inflation issues, and also fact credibility. As such, these are all long-term issues.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们主张更关注短端国债收益率以及投资级公司债。因为我们看到经济动能仍然相当强劲。
subtitles.en: So we're advocating a closer look into probably a shorter and treasuries yields and also investment grade corporate bonds. And because we see how the economic momentum remains quite robust.

subtitles.zh: 这实际上应该会支撑高收益债的违约率保持在相对低位，并使其利差维持较窄。这难道只是我们正在回归常态的感觉吗？
subtitles.en: That should actually support it for the default rate for high yield to also become, say, relatively low and pressed to be quite tight. Is this just a sense that we're just heading back to normal?

subtitles.zh: 我的意思是，后疫情时代那种0%利率的日子已经一去不复返了。但我想，这是否正如你一直所说的，我们看到的并不是真正的经济困境。
subtitles.en: I mean, gone are the days that we used to see 0% rates post-COVID, the like. But I think is it just that then actually what you've been saying, that this is not really economic distress that we're seeing.

subtitles.zh: 更多是与财政可持续性有关。而且这实际上是一个全球现象。不仅仅是在美国，我们在英国和欧洲等地也看到了。
subtitles.en: The law and is more with regards to fiscal sustainability. And it's actually global phenomenon too. It's not just US we see in UK and Europe, etc.

subtitles.en: But to us, it's not about avoiding AI completely, because it's impossible to do that in nowadays. But to identify the stages, different stages, before it was like from the hyperscaler, so we say it's AI spenders, and now it's the AI owners,

subtitles.en: But we need to think a few steps ahead, so right now it may be the AI users into various sectors like healthcare and also into robotics, where China has a competitive advantage.

subtitles.zh: 一个关键点，一个有趣的事情是，我们很多人都承认美国擅长高端模型，比如那些顶级机器。但中国擅长性价比。
subtitles.en: And one key thing, one interesting thing is a lot of us acknowledge how US is good at the premium models, like the machines, three stars, etc. But China is good at its value for money.

briefs.speaker: Nicholas Choi
briefs.current_title: 富兰克林邓普顿蔡崇信：新股配置策略，长期持有还是二级加仓？
current_title_lines: 富兰克林邓普顿蔡崇信

subtitles.zh: 你们是在二级市场进入，还是试图获得配售？我知道这有点笼统，但持有期大概是怎样的？
subtitles.en: Do you come in in the secondary market, or do you try and get an allocation? I know this is generalizing things, but what's the holding period looking like?

subtitles.zh: 是的。我们试图在新股发行时参与这些交易，并长期持有。这是我们的基础。最佳类型的新股参与者。没错。
subtitles.en: Yeah. So, we've tried to go into these deals at IPO, and hold on to them. So, that's been our base. The best type of IPO investor. Correct.

subtitles.zh: 这仍然占大多数，我们能够获得不错的配售，以好价格持有，在某些情况下我们也会在上市后加仓。
subtitles.en: And that's still the large majority of that, where we've been able to get decent allocations that we're able to hang on at a good price, and I guess where there are certain circumstances where we've actually added on post market as well.

subtitles.zh: 因为配售非常难获得。所以并不是说我在新股发行时就能得到我真正想要的完整配售。
subtitles.en: Because allocations are very difficult to come by. So, it isn't like I get the full allocation that I really want at the IPO itself.

subtitles.zh: 所以实际上有很多情况下我们不得不加仓。但有趣的是，我们对这些加仓标的的信心水平相当高。
subtitles.en: So, there are actually numerous cases where we've had to add on. But the interesting thing here is the conviction levels that we have on these names, where we add on, would be quite high.

subtitles.zh: 因为我们做功课，花时间，但最终它代表了在中国呈现给我们的新机会集。过去我们无法参与。
subtitles.en: Because we do the work, we're spending the time, but ultimately it represents a new opportunity set that's actually presented to us in China. That, you know, kind of in the past, we wouldn't have been able to invest in.
